name: WebHostingPad
tagline: Budget US shared hosting with unlimited storage and a 30-day guarantee
description: WebHostingPad is a budget US shared hosting provider offering unlimited storage, a free domain and SSL, and a 30-day money-back guarantee on new accounts.
about: WebHostingPad is a US-based shared hosting provider aimed at small sites and beginners, built around low entry-level pricing and unlimited hosting space on its main plans.

Shared hosting comes in a few tiers: the entry Power Plan, Power Plan Plus (adds WordPress optimization and priority support), and several Power Plan Plus + WordPress bundles (Basic, Pro, Premium) that layer on managed WordPress tools. A separate low-cost Power Plan Mini is available at a flat, non-escalating rate. All main plans include a free domain for the first year, a free SSL certificate, unlimited bandwidth, email accounts and databases.

On a standard 1-year term, the Power Plan starts around $3.99/month and renews around $6.49/month; longer prepaid terms (3-5 years) bring the effective monthly rate down further but lock in that term upfront. Note that WebHostingPad's default control panel is not cPanel — cPanel access costs an extra $1/month on top of plan pricing, so factor that in if cPanel specifically is a requirement.
policies: WebHostingPad offers a 30-day money-back guarantee on new shared hosting accounts. The guarantee excludes renewal payments, add-on services (including the cPanel upgrade), and domain registration fees, and only applies to accounts that haven't violated the company's Terms of Service.
